Name: Boss Battle
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
Boss Battle
Currently in beta with two bosses: Slime King and Bat Lord. More bosses will be added in future updates.
Challenge bosses in custom caverns and earn unique rewards:
Slime Scepter: Summon two knights to help with combat or gathering.
Echo Necklace: Use sonar to find resources, ladders, and hidden buried caches.
How to play: Interact with the elevator at the mine entrance and choose a boss cavern.
Requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.1.10+, and Content Patcher 2.9.0+. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
Installation: Extract the Boss Battle folder into Mods, keeping both bundled components. Remove older versions before updating.
Supports English and Simplified Chinese. Single-player only. Feedback and bug reports are welcome!
Custom artwork was developed with AI assistance.


Boss Battle
目前为测试版，包含史莱姆王和蝙蝠领主两个 Boss，后续将更新更多 Boss。
在专属洞窟中挑战 Boss，赢取独特奖励：
史莱姆权杖： 召唤两名骑士，协助战斗或采集资源。
回音项链： 使用声纳寻找资源、楼梯和隐藏挖掘宝箱。
进入方式： 与矿井入口处的电梯互动，选择 Boss 洞窟。
运行要求： 星露谷物语 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.1.10+、Content Patcher 2.9.0+。通用模组配置菜单为可选。
安装方法： 将 Boss Battle 文件夹解压到 Mods，保留其中两个组件。更新前请移除旧版本。
支持中文和英文，仅限单人游戏。欢迎反馈体验与问题！
自定义美术素材采用 AI 辅助制作。
